issue.title: Tiered morning review walk with daily lane review
issue.description: `]s` / `[s` and Ctrl+Alt+J/K walk one shared review queue in explicit tiers, NEW → PENDING → NEXT → RETURNED → ROTTEN. Pending and Next tasks come due for a daily review set by new `pending_interval` / `next_interval` keys (default 1 day). ROTTEN sorts by interval, then lateness, then newest `created`. The walk tells Bryan by tier where he is, when the commitments are done, and that ROTTEN is stoppable upkeep. No stamps are stripped, and the seed is never run again.
